text:
elena.partnerships: AMD contacted us about a small early access preview for their MI300 refresh. They're offering 2 test cards + a telemetry SDK. Interested in running a Short EAP to validate throughput and perf-per-watt before we accept a marketplace listing. NDA attached: https://amd.example/nda/mi300-refresh.pdf
omar.bench: sounds good. single node first? curious about interconnect (NVLink vs equivalent).
elena.partnerships: they said single-node initially; if results good we scale to multi-node later. Jason from AMD will confirm interconnect details and firmware.
jason_amd: correct 1 we will supply 2 cards (MI300r-L & MI300r-S), firmware image, and a lightweight telemetry agent. target window: 2 weeks after samples arrive.
tess.legal: NDA quick read: two asks from our side 1 ensure we can retain anonymized benchmark metrics, and clarify publication approval window. I'll send redlines today.
ryan.eng-runtime: heads-up: runtime needs a `mi300-mode` kernel flag and we may need to pin math library versions. I'll validate container install steps.
omar.bench: proposed run plan: 1) baseline float16 vs q5/q8 runs; 2) cold vs warm attention cache latencies; 3) sustained throughput 1hr run, sample at 10s; 4) perf-per-watt with telemetry agent. we'll capture p50/p95/p99 + token/sec + watt-hours.
meera.eng-ml: please include the regression eval set `redwood/mi300-eap-regress` and a small hallucination checklist. will run our scoring scripts and share diffs.
jason_amd: we can also provide power envelopes and a sample power curve tool. shipping ETA is Tue next week. we'll include a short acceptance test `amd_fw_check.sh`.
tess.legal: redlines uploaded: https://drive.redwood/nda-redlines/mi300. main thing: 14-day marketing embargo after Redwood publishes internal report. we want to avoid open press before joint announcement.
elena.partnerships: action items: tess -> finalize NDA; omar -> bench harness & upload path; ryan -> container + kernel flag; meera -> eval set prep; jason -> confirm shipment + acceptance tests. keep comms here.
omar.bench: I'll add harness under /bench/mi300-eap and will use `./bench_driver --config bench/mi300_eap.yaml --repeats 2` to run. artifacts to s3://redwood-eap/amd-mi300/17691.
ryan.eng-runtime: building container now, will post image sha. note: add ENV AMD_TELEMETRY=1 and mount telemetry socket. also suggest setting `RUNTIME_AUTOTUNE=false` for stability.
meera.eng-ml: eval set uploaded and expected metrics doc posted: https://drive.redwood/mi300-eap/eval_spec. small ask: include a tiny safety smoke test for outputs containing PII patterns.
jason_amd: noted. we'll also include a short runbook for firmware rollback if the patch causes regressions.
elena.partnerships: tentative timeline: NDA signed by Thu EOD, samples arrive Tue, bench window Wed-Fri, internal review Mon, then sync with AMD for marketplace preview go/no-go.
tess.legal: NDA signed and returned. added clause to allow Redwood to keep aggregated metrics for internal ops.
omar.bench: quick metric Q: include raw latency traces for p99 spikes and raw token logs?
elena.partnerships: yes to traces; token logs should be sanitized. follow our data handling checklist.
jason_amd: courier pickup scheduled Mon evening. firmware and telemetry docs in the package. excited to see the numbers. :rocket:
elena.partnerships: great teamwork 1 I'll schedule a 15min async recap Fri to collect early numbers.
